answer: The cooperage yard holds oak staves stacked to season, hoops piled in a corner. Proof of cooper via oak barrel tally — a barrel the cooper hoops only after 27 barrels hold their seal without one leaking at the stave, each hooped by the cooper himself. canyon joints each stave and sets them in the raising ring. zenith drives the hoops down and hammers them tight. marble fires the inside and bungs the barrel shut. Twenty-seven barrels must hold their seal without one leaking at the stave, and the next still leaks where a stave ran warped.
